svg.title: Ardalan Askarian. Open to full-time software and ML roles. Software engineer working on machine learning systems, and the ordinary software that has to hold them up. M.Sc. Computer Science, University of Saskatchewan, Applied ML stream. Computer vision and image processing, under Dr. Mark Eramian.
